player_prompt.intro: O jẹ oṣere {player_id} ni 3-player Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma. Idaraya naa pẹ {num_rounds} awọn iyipo. Ẹya iyipo: • {conv_rounds} awọn iyipo iwiregbe ọfẹ • 1 ipinnu ipinnu - fi ami kan fun alatako: '[<opp-id> cooperate]' tabi '[<opp-id> defect]' (ie '[1 defect] [2 cooperate]'; aiyipada ni 'ṣiṣẹpọ'). Matrix isanwo ti o ni imọran (ti a lo si ọkọọkan awọn tọkọtaya ti ko ni aṣẹ): - Mejeeji ṣe ifowosowopo -> {reward} - Mejeeji jẹ alailẹgbẹ -> {punishment} - O jẹ alailẹgbẹ, wọn ṣe ifowosowopo -> {temptation} - O ṣe ifowosowopo, wọn jẹ alailẹgbẹ -> {sucker} Awọn oṣere) pẹlu awọn aami ti o ga julọ ni opin gbogbo awọn iyipo.

round.start: ─── Ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ Ìyí {round} ─── Ẹ lè bá ara yín sọ̀rọ̀ fàlàlà fún ìyí {conv_rounds} tó ń bọ̀.
round.chat_finished: Ifẹsẹ̀wọ̀nsẹ̀ tan an fún ẹ̀rún {round}. Fi ìpinnu rẹ̀ sílẹ̀, ọ̀kan tókẹ́nì fún ọ̀tọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan: `[pid cooperate]` tàbí `[pid defect]`.
